panel:
精确局部编辑，用于游戏可直接混合的湿版UI底图素材。
图1是必须严格对齐的干版底图，622×1536比例；图2仅是用户确认的水膜材质参考，禁止把其中任何头像、文字、HP/SAN条、横向分隔线加到结果里。
输出单个空白完整面板，与图1同一比例、同样全画布占位，透明背景。严格保持图1外框轮廓、顶部与底部装饰、每个角、直边及内侧边界位置，不裁切、不增加留白、不改变镜头。顶底端盖形状不能变化，圆形装饰不可拉伸。
把图1变为被海浪打湿的版本，湿润材质必须采用图2已确认的效果：底板假设是一整张基本光滑的深色金属板，不是瓦片、石头或皮革。上面的透明连续薄水膜有宽幅柔和的冷蓝天空倒影、右侧有局部温暖金色火把倒影，湿膜部分光滑通透，仍保留深黑底色。水膜主要位于右侧和中部，迎浪方向右上到左下，形状自然连通逐渐变薄。局部边缘有极细柔和高光，绝不整圈勾线。上部与下部均有少量湿光，不是一个平铺重复纹样。对齐图1外框，只改变光泽和少量颜色，材质本身能读成刚被打湿的黑金属。
不要瓦片分块、裂纹、白色斜纹、粗糙石材、大理石、粉笔划痕、线条画、规则水珠、卡通星点、泡沫、文字、头像、额外UI。不要生成图2的中横框。原素材图1透明区保持真正透明RGBA。
torch:
Precise wet-material edit for a production game sprite. Input 1 is the EXACT original dry torch-and-hand sprite, native 768x1152. Input 2 is the user-approved full-game wet look: take ONLY the wet WOOD / WRAPPINGS / LEATHER GLOVE AND SLEEVE material from the left-hand torch in that image. Output ONE transparent RGBA sprite, same 2:3 canvas ratio and same object scale and placement as input1. Absolutely preserve the input1 object geometry, individual fingers, glove folds, sleeve shape, wrist bands, the torch's angle, shaft width, tip position and every silhouette contour. No shifting, resizing, cropping or extra margin. The dry and wet sprites will crossfade perfectly in-place, so alignment is critical.
Change only reflectivity and local wet coloration of the existing artwork. Reproduce the APPROVED wet look from input2: broad irregular glossy wet patches on the glove back following its leather wrinkles, bronze/amber rim reflections on the wrist bands, connected narrow moist reflections flowing ALONG the wooden shaft and wood grain, glossy irregular high points on the dark bindings. Wet surface reflects cool night sky and the warm torch above. Preserve rough dry gaps and deep creases; source texture and geometry remain discernible. Splash came from upper right to lower left, with glossy patches tapering down-left. Keep the appearance realistic and weathered, the same warm/cold strengths as the approved screenshot. This is baked wet artwork, NOT a drawing of droplet outlines or noise.
Do NOT add flame (the original sprite has none; flame is a separate animated layer). Do not include the game background, player panel, sea, cards, smoke, particles, floor, floating droplets or any other objects. No separate beads, no white outlines, no chalk scratches, no change of glove design. All existing transparent areas must stay genuinely transparent. Single matched sprite, no side-by-side layout.
